text:
Alex Kim: Following up from the DB connection-pool exhaustion postmortem — putting action items in one place. Please confirm owner, Jira ticket if you create one, and an ETA. I'll be the approver where noted.

Alex Kim: 1) Add circuit-breaker + max-wait telemetry on DB client (R: Maria, A: Alex, C: Sam) — estimate: 2 wks.
Alex Kim: 2) Emergency runbook update for pool saturation (R: Sam, I: Oncall) — estimate: 3 days.
Alex Kim: 3) Autoscaling policy tweak for read-replicas (R: Jess, C: EngSRE) — estimate: 1 week.
Alex Kim: 4) Long-term: connection pooling library upgrade and perf test (R: Maria, C: Research) — estimate: 4 wks.

Maria Lopez: I'll take #1 and #4. Creating Jira now.
Maria Lopez: Created RED-21011 for CB+telemetry and RED-21012 for pool-lib-upgrade. Assigning to myself, due 2026-04-05 for RED-21011 and 2026-04-26 for RED-21012.
oncall-bot: Jira RED-21011 created and linked (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-21011) - assignee: Maria Lopez - due: 2026-04-05
oncall-bot: Jira RED-21012 created and linked (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-21012) - assignee: Maria Lopez - due: 2026-04-26

Sam Turner: I'll take #2 (runbook). Will add the immediate mitigation steps + screenshots from incident logs. Putting RED-21013 on my plate. ETA 2026-03-26.
oncall-bot: Jira RED-21013 created - assignee: Sam Turner - due: 2026-03-26

Jess Patel: For #3, I can tweak autoscaling but need a quick sync with infra cost owner. Putting RED-21014, assigned to me. ETA 2026-03-31.
oncall-bot: Jira RED-21014 created - assignee: Jess Patel - due: 2026-03-31

Alex Kim: Thanks all. Quick RACI note for the record:
```
Item | R | A | C | I
1 CB+telemetry | Maria | Alex | Sam | Oncall
2 Runbook | Sam | Alex | Oncall | Eng
3 Autoscale | Jess | Alex | Infra | Product
4 Lib upgrade | Maria | Alex | Research | Eng
```

Jess Patel: One more thing — this is the 3rd pool-related incident in ~6 weeks (see RED-19002, RED-20340). We should add a retrospective item to look at customer impact and whether our default pool config is wrong.

Maria Lopez: Agree. For RED-21012 (lib upgrade) I'll include a short eval plan and regression tests. Will post the perf test harness link in the ticket.

Sam Turner: Handoff note: once RED-21013 runbook is merged, please @oncall rotation so people know the new steps. I'll add a short blurb for the nightly oncall email.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem follow-up check-in in 7 days (channel: #postmortems)

Alex Kim: Can we commit to check-in milestones in Jira: "PR opened", "QA passed", "Staged rollout" with dates? If owners agree, I'll mark Alex (me) as Approver on all tickets.

Maria Lopez: Yes — I'll add the three workflow milestones and update the ticket templates.

Jess Patel: I'll block time on infra calendar Thurs to validate autoscale templates; will update RED-21014 with notes.

Alex Kim: Perfect. When each ticket moves to status = Done, please drop a short note here tagging DRI so we can close the postmortem action items. Thanks :thumbsup:

Maria Lopez: Ack.
Sam Turner: Ack.
Jess Patel: Ack.
